headline: Discussed a request for trash cans at Keach Park and the carry-in, carry-out sign; recommended a concrete process for issues brought to the committee.
summary: The committee discussed a request to add trash cans at Keach Park. Members also discussed a recently installed carry-in, carry-out sign and whether that policy works for people without cars or who use mobility aids. The committee recommended a concrete process for issues brought to it and asked to hear from David Gill again at the next meeting.
decisions: Recommended instituting a concrete process for handling issues brought to the committee.

decision_evidence.quote: Recommendation to institute a concrete process when there is an issue that is brought to the committee, multiple perspectives related to that matter were shared.

decision_titles: Concrete process for issues brought to the committee
